references.text: This verse contains the original prohibition against sexual intercourse between a woman and an animal, for which Leviticus 20:16 prescribes the penalty.
Exodus forbids sexual intercourse with animals and sets forth the death penalty, which aligns with the punishment in Leviticus 20:16.
Deuteronomy pronounces a curse on anyone who has sexual intercourse with an animal, confirming the seriousness of this sin.
The preceding verse deals with the same type of offense committed by a man, with the same penalty - death for both the person and the animal.
